edits.name: slide-slide
edits.prompt: The sloth in Picture 1 is sliding fast down a smooth chute away from us, sitting the way the sloth in Picture 2 sits: he leans back a little and holds both arms out low to the sides for balance, paws open, elbows slightly bent. Keep him seen exactly from behind as in Picture 1, sitting on his bottom with his legs stretched out in front of him so only the soles of his feet show below him, the same brown fur seen from the back, the same pale bandage wrist wraps, the same thin brown satchel strap running from his left shoulder down to the small brown bag on his right hip, the same thin dark outline, the same soft painted cartoon style, the same size and the same flat plain grey background. Nothing else in the picture.
